guarantees.claim: Function returns prd where each WidthPRDSBox-bit slice i is the concatenation {prd_msbs[i], prd_lsbs[i]} for i from 0 to 3.

formal.consequent: prd[0*WidthPRDSBox +: WidthPRDSBox] == {prd_msbs[0], prd_lsbs[0]} && prd[1*WidthPRDSBox +: WidthPRDSBox] == {prd_msbs[1], prd_lsbs[1]} && prd[2*WidthPRDSBox +: WidthPRDSBox] == {prd_msbs[2], prd_lsbs[2]} && prd[3*WidthPRDSBox +: WidthPRDSBox] == {prd_msbs[3], prd_lsbs[3]}

formal_sketch.consequent: prd[0*WidthPRDSBox +: WidthPRDSBox] == {prd_msbs[0], prd_lsbs[0]} && prd[1*WidthPRDSBox +: WidthPRDSBox] == {prd_msbs[1], prd_lsbs[1]} && prd[2*WidthPRDSBox +: WidthPRDSBox] == {prd_msbs[2], prd_lsbs[2]} && prd[3*WidthPRDSBox +: WidthPRDSBox] == {prd_msbs[3], prd_lsbs[3]}

uncertain_points.claim: If the module-level parameter WidthPRDSBox is inconsistent with the actual widths of prd_lsbs/prd_msbs used in the masking domain, the concatenation may produce malformed masks, weakening side-channel resistance.
uncertain_points.cond: WidthPRDSBox does not match the real bit-width expectations of the PRD LSBS/MSBS producers/consumers.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect mask concatenation could reduce PRD entropy or create predictable masks, exposing secret-dependent side-channel leakage.

formal_sketch.antecedent: WidthPRDSBox does not match the real bit-width expectations of the PRD LSBS/MSBS producers/consumers
formal_sketch.consequent: the concatenation may produce malformed masks, weakening side-channel resistance

security_implications: Function constructs PRD (mask) values by concatenation. An incorrect WidthPRDSBox could break mask generation integrity, potentially leading to insufficient masking and side-channel leakage of key-dependent data.
